# The database

<!-- Generated by backend/db/docs.js from backend/db/schema/ - do not edit by hand. -->

Agora keeps its data in PocketBase (SQLite). This is structure version 4: every table, every field with its meaning, and the
links between them. The same texts appear next to each field on PocketBase's admin page (port 8090).

## Rules of the house

- A table is named `<area>_<things>` (`finance_payments`, `event_duties`); `users` (PocketBase's login table) and `events` are the
  main tables of their areas.
- Fields are camelCase. A link is named after what it points to (`member`, `event`, `user`) and is a real link: the admin page
  opens the linked record.
- Money is always a whole number of cents in a field ending in `Cents` (`amountCents: 5000` is 50.00) - no rounding errors.
- A calendar day is text `YYYY-MM-DD`, a month `YYYY-MM`, a moment in time a date field (UTC).
- Fixed choices are select fields; every table has `created` and `updated`.
- `original` (in many tables): exactly how an older app wrote a record where the columns cannot show it (an amount typed as
  "50,00", a link to something deleted since). Only the old API reads it; it is empty for almost every record. Do not edit it.
- Every table is the server's alone: no app and no member token reads it directly; the server checks every permission.
- Do not change records on the admin page while the app runs unless you know what the server expects: it does not check them.

## Areas

- **Accounts and groups**: `user_groups`
- **Finance**: `finance_members`, `finance_payments`, `finance_status_periods`, `finance_standing_orders`, `finance_donations`, `finance_expenses`, `finance_requests`, `finance_fee_changes`, `finance_fresh_starts`, `finance_changes`, `finance_ledger` (view), `finance_monthly_totals` (view)
- **Events**: `events`, `event_registrations`, `event_guests`, `event_duties`, `event_program_items`
- **Community**: `community_songs`, `community_prayers`, `community_polls`
- **Mentoring**: `mentoring_mentors`, `mentoring_threads`, `mentoring_messages`
- **Media library**: `media_folder_rules`
- **System**: `system_settings`, `system_secrets`, `system_push_devices`, `system_content_reports`, `system_migrations`
- **Accounts**: `users` (PocketBase's login table; fields below)

## users

The login accounts (PocketBase's own table: e-mail address, password and verification are PocketBase's fields).

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| firstName | text | First name. |
| lastName | text | Last name. |
| admin | bool | Administrator of the instance. |
| owner | bool | The owner of the instance (exactly one; set up the instance). |
| pays | bool | Pays fees (has a member record in the books). |
| groups | link → user_groups (several) | The groups the person belongs to (their permissions add up). |
| notificationSettings | json | Which messages the person gets, by channel: {"channels": {"push": true, "email": false}, "push": {...}, "email": {...}}. |
| language | text | Language of the person's app (en, de; empty: the instance's). |
| timeZone | text | Time zone of the person's app (IANA name). |
| calendarToken | text | Secret key of the person's calendar feed (empty until first used). |
| original | json | Exactly how an older app wrote this record where the columns cannot show it (e.g. an amount typed as "50,00", a field it left out). Only for older apps; empty for almost every record. Do not edit. |

## Accounts and groups

### user_groups

Groups of members. A group gives its members permissions, can be the audience of events and be given duties.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| name | text (required, shown as its name) | Name of the group. |
| permissions | one of: view_finances, manage_finances, manage_registration_code, access_ai, manage_mentoring, manage_events, manage_songbook, manage_prayers, manage_media (several) | What members of the group may do. |
| original | json | Exactly how an older app wrote this record where the columns cannot show it (e.g. an amount typed as "50,00", a field it left out). Only for older apps; empty for almost every record. Do not edit. |
| created | moment (set by the database) | When the record was created (set by the database). |
| updated | moment (set by the database) | When the record was last changed (set by the database). |

Indexes: `unique (name)`

## Finance

### finance_members

Everyone in the books: name, income status, membership days, and the link to their login. Payments, status periods and standing orders point here.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (kept from before the upgrade, or made by PocketBase) | The record id. Records from before the upgrade keep the id the apps gave them. |
| name | text (required, shown as its name) | Full name as it appears in the books. |
| user | link → users | The member's login account (empty: the member has no account). |
| status | one of: vollverdiener, geringverdiener, keinverdiener, pausiert | Income status today; it decides the monthly fee. Earlier statuses are in finance_status_periods. |
| memberSince | day (YYYY-MM-DD) | Day the (current) membership started. |
| originalMemberSince | day (YYYY-MM-DD) | Day of the very first membership; the fee account counts from it. |
| pays | bool | Whether the member pays fees. |
| isDeleted | bool | Deleted member: only the name and the payments stay, for the books. |
| original | json | Exactly how an older app wrote this record where the columns cannot show it (e.g. an amount typed as "50,00", a field it left out). Only for older apps; empty for almost every record. Do not edit. |
| created | moment (set by the database) | When the record was created (set by the database). |
| updated | moment (set by the database) | When the record was last changed (set by the database). |

Indexes: `(user)`, `(name)`, `(status)`

| created | moment (set by the database) | When the record was created (set by the database). |

### finance_fee_changes

The monthly fees over time: the fees from the beginning (fromMonth empty) and every change, each with the month it counts from. A month costs the fees of the latest change at or before it.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| fromMonth | month (YYYY-MM) | First month these fees count for (empty: from the beginning). |
| feesCents | json | Monthly fee per income status in cents, e.g. {"vollverdiener": 5000, "geringverdiener": 2500}. |
| setAt | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the change was entered. |
| setBy | text | Account id of who entered it (may belong to an account deleted since). |
| setByName | text | Name of who entered it. |
| created | moment (set by the database) | When the record was created (set by the database). |
| updated | moment (set by the database) | When the record was last changed (set by the database). |

Indexes: `unique (fromMonth)`

### finance_ledger (view)

All money in one list (read-only view): member payments and donations come in, expenses go out.

```sql
SELECT id, kind, date, amountCents, who, description, member, receipt FROM (
SELECT ('p' || p.id) AS id, 'memberPayment' AS kind, p.date AS date, p.amountCents AS amountCents, m.name AS who, p.description AS description, p.member AS member, p.receipt AS receipt FROM finance_payments p LEFT JOIN finance_members m ON m.id = p.member
UNION ALL SELECT ('d' || d.id) AS id, 'donation' AS kind, d.date AS date, d.amountCents AS amountCents, d.donorName AS who, d.description AS description, '' AS member, '' AS receipt FROM finance_donations d
UNION ALL SELECT ('e' || e.id) AS id, 'expense' AS kind, e.date AS date, e.amountCents AS amountCents, e.issuer AS who, e.description AS description, '' AS member, e.receipt AS receipt FROM finance_expenses e
)
```

### finance_monthly_totals (view)

Money per month and kind (read-only view): the sum and the number of entries.

```sql
SELECT (substr(date, 1, 7) || '-' || kind) AS id, substr(date, 1, 7) AS month, kind, SUM(amountCents) AS totalCents, COUNT(*) AS entries FROM (
SELECT date, 'memberPayment' AS kind, amountCents FROM finance_payments
UNION ALL SELECT date, 'donation' AS kind, amountCents FROM finance_donations
UNION ALL SELECT date, 'expense' AS kind, amountCents FROM finance_expenses
) WHERE date != '' GROUP BY substr(date, 1, 7), kind
```

## Events

### events

Events and appointments in the calendar.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| title | text (required, shown as its name) | Title. |
| date | day (YYYY-MM-DD) (required) | Day it takes place (the first day of a longer event). |
| endDate | day (YYYY-MM-DD) | Last day of an event that lasts several days (empty: one day). |
| startTime | time of day (HH:mm) | Start time HH:mm (empty: all day). |
| endTime | time of day (HH:mm) | End time HH:mm. |
| location | text | Where. |
| description | text | Description (formatted text). |
| eventType | one of: event, termin | event: an event of the community; termin: an appointment. |
| status | text | State of the event (scheduled unless an app set something else). |
| isRecurring | bool | Marked as a recurring event. |
| recurringRule | text | The repetition it was created with. |
| requiresRegistration | bool | Members (and guests) sign up for it. |
| minParticipants | whole number | Least number of participants (0: none). |
| maxParticipants | whole number | Places (0: no limit); who signs up later is on the waiting list. |
| targetGroups | link → user_groups (several) | Only these groups see the event (empty and no unmatchedTargetGroups: everyone). |
| unmatchedTargetGroups | json | Target groups named in older data that match no group (they still match a group of that name; the event stays hidden from everyone else). |
| isPinned | bool | Pinned to the top. |
| imageUrl | text | Picture (/api/events/images/... or a web address). |
| createdBy | link → users | Who created it. |
| isPublic | bool | Shared: people without an account can open it through its link. |
| publicToken | text | The key in the share link (kept when sharing is switched off and on again). |
| programUpdated | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the order of service was last saved. |
| original | json | Exactly how an older app wrote this record where the columns cannot show it (e.g. an amount typed as "50,00", a field it left out). Only for older apps; empty for almost every record. Do not edit. |
| created | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was created (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |
| updated | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was last changed (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |

Indexes: `(date)`, `(status)`, `(createdBy)`, `unique (publicToken) WHERE publicToken != ''`

| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (kept from before the upgrade, or made by PocketBase) | The record id. Records from before the upgrade keep the id the apps gave them. |
| title | text (shown as its name) | Question. |
| description | text | Explanation. |
| options | json | The choices: [{"id": "o1", "text": "..."}]. |
| isMultiple | bool | Several choices allowed. |
| endsAt | moment (date and time, UTC) | When voting ends. |
| creatorHash | text | Keyed hash of who created it. |
| tallies | json | Votes per choice ({"o1": 3}); empty when fewer than three voted by the end. |
| voters | json | Keyed hashes of who voted, in random order (no link to a choice). |
| original | json | Exactly how an older app wrote this record where the columns cannot show it (e.g. an amount typed as "50,00", a field it left out). Only for older apps; empty for almost every record. Do not edit. |
| created | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was created (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |
| updated | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was last changed (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |

## Mentoring

### mentoring_mentors

Members who offer mentoring (after a mentoring manager approved them).

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| user | link → users | The mentor's account. |
| status | one of: pending, approved, rejected | pending, approved or rejected. |
| bio | text | What the mentor writes about themselves. |
| maxMentees | whole number | How many conversations the mentor takes at most. |
| isAccepting | bool | Takes new conversations. |
| original | json | Exactly how an older app wrote this record where the columns cannot show it (e.g. an amount typed as "50,00", a field it left out). Only for older apps; empty for almost every record. Do not edit. |
| created | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was created (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |
| updated | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was last changed (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |

Indexes: `unique (user) WHERE user != ''`, `(status)`

### mentoring_threads

Conversations between a mentor and a mentee. The mentee stays anonymous to the mentor (alias).

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| mentor | link → users | The mentor's account. |
| mentee | link → users | The mentee's account (never shown to the mentor). |
| menteeAlias | text (shown as its name) | The name the mentor sees. |
| status | one of: active, open, closed, blocked_mentor, blocked_mentee | State of the conversation. |
| lastMessage | text | The beginning of the newest message (encrypted). |
| original | json | Exactly how an older app wrote this record where the columns cannot show it (e.g. an amount typed as "50,00", a field it left out). Only for older apps; empty for almost every record. Do not edit. |
| created | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was created (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |
| updated | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was last changed (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |

Indexes: `(mentor)`, `(mentee)`

### mentoring_messages

Messages of a conversation (texts encrypted). Deleted with the conversation.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| thread | link → mentoring_threads, deleted with it | The conversation. |
| senderRole | one of: mentor, mentee | Who wrote it: mentor or mentee. |
| text | text | The message (encrypted). |
| isRead | bool | Read by the other side. |
| original | json | Exactly how an older app wrote this record where the columns cannot show it (e.g. an amount typed as "50,00", a field it left out). Only for older apps; empty for almost every record. Do not edit. |
| created | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was created (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |
| updated | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the record was last changed (kept from before the upgrade for older records). |

Indexes: `(thread, created)`, `(thread, isRead)`

## Media library

### media_folder_rules

Who may read, write or not see a folder of the media library (Nextcloud). One record per folder and group / person / everyone.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| folder | text | Folder path in the media library ("" = the top). |
| target | one of: everyone, group, user | Whom the rule is for. |
| group | link → user_groups, deleted with it | The group (target group). Removed with the group. |
| user | link → users, deleted with it | The person (target user). Removed with the account. |
| level | one of: read, write, hide | read, write or hide. |
| created | moment (set by the database) | When the record was created (set by the database). |
| updated | moment (set by the database) | When the record was last changed (set by the database). |

Indexes: `unique (folder, target, `group`, user)`

## System

### system_settings

Settings of the instance, one record per area (registration, finance, ai, media, push; legacy: values older versions left that nothing reads any more).

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| area | one of: registration, finance, ai, media, push, compat, legacy (required) | Which settings. |
| value | json | The settings of the area. |
| created | moment (set by the database) | When the record was created (set by the database). |
| updated | moment (set by the database) | When the record was last changed (set by the database). |

Indexes: `unique (area)`

### system_secrets

Secrets the server needs, kept apart from the settings: the API key of the AI service, the private key of web push, the password of the media account.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (made by PocketBase) | The record's id. |
| name | one of: aiApiKey, vapidPrivateKey, mediaPassword (required) | Which secret. |
| value | text | The secret as the server uses it (mediaPassword is encrypted with media-secret in the data folder). |
| created | moment (set by the database) | When the record was created (set by the database). |
| updated | moment (set by the database) | When the record was last changed (set by the database). |

Indexes: `unique (name)`

| token | text | Android: the Firebase token. |

### system_migrations

History of the upgrades of this database: what ran when, the backup taken before, and the check report.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | text (kept from before the upgrade, or made by PocketBase) | The upgrade (e.g. v4-structure). |
| status | one of: running, done, failed, blocked | running, done, failed (tried again at the next start) or blocked (waits; see report). |
| attempts | whole number | How often it was started. |
| startedAt | moment (date and time, UTC) | When the last attempt started. |
| finishedAt | moment (date and time, UTC) | When it finished. |
| appVersion | text | Version of the app that ran it. |
| backup | text | Name of the backup taken before (in the backups folder of the database). |
| report | json | What the check and the comparison found (counts and totals; no personal data). |
| error | text | Why the last attempt failed. |
| created | moment (set by the database) | When the record was created (set by the database). |
| updated | moment (set by the database) | When the record was last changed (set by the database). |
